name: trato
description: Trato - Compra y vende propiedades directo, sin corredores

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @trato/backend" "npm run dev -w @trato/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trato/backend && npm run build -w @trato/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @trato/backend && npm run lint -w @trato/frontend
